init.title: CloudEdge options
init.description: Saving a change reloads the integration and ends the live views in progress.

data.battery_max_live_minutes: Battery cameras: maximum live view time (minutes)
data.battery_keepalive: Battery cameras: keep streaming while someone is watching

data_description.refresh_interval: How often device status and settings are read from the cloud.
data_description.battery_max_live_minutes: After this time the live view stops and the camera rests: 1 minute at first, doubling up to 1 hour for as long as a viewer stays connected. 0 removes the limit.
data_description.battery_keepalive: When off, the camera ends each live window on its own after about 2 minutes, and the picture freezes for up to a minute while the next window opens.
data_description.stream_audio: Turn off for a video-only stream, for example if playback stalls.

confirm.title: "Preload camera stream" keeps {camera} awake
confirm.description:
{camera} runs on a battery. With "Preload camera stream" enabled, Home Assistant keeps its live stream open even when nobody is watching: the camera is woken again and again, and its battery drains.

Submit to turn the preload off for this camera.
